Question: What are the best app marketing strategies?
Answer: One of the easiest and most affordable app marketing strategies is app store optimization (ASO). This is the practice of editing and adjusting your app store listing(s) to make sure your app(s) rank highly in Google Play and App Store searches. There are a number of factors you’ll need to focus on to improve ASO, but the most critical are keywords, conversion rates, localization, downloads, ratings, and reviews. Of course, downloads, ratings, and reviews are largely out of your control, but the rest are fairly easy to optimize. With keywords, you can often find solid options just by looking at which ones your competitors use. Alternatively, you can use solutions like our keyword APIs to find ones that will bring a lot of traffic to your store listings. You should include them in your app title, subtitle, keyword field, description, and store listing text. Conversion rate optimization is less scientific, but very simple to adjust. It deals with altering the visual and textual aspects of your store listings. The goal here is to match the tone and design to your target audience. Finally, localization generally refers to translating your app and app store listing to cater to the regions where your app is available. Hope this helps!
